description: baseline: single-threaded driver, port gates pass, 6.3 tok/s

asi.hypothesis: single-threaded C+NEON driver baseline; memory-bound at ~540MB weights per token over Pi4 ~4GB/s bus

description: 3-thread OpenMP GEMV slower (+4%): memory wall confirmed, reverted

asi.hypothesis: 3-thread static-partition OpenMP GEMV would better saturate Pi4 DRAM bus
asi.next_action_hint: workload is memory-wall bound (~552MB/token over ~4GB/s bus = 138ms floor; at 159ms already 87% efficient). Next: compiler flags (-O3 -mcpu=cortex-a72) then fuse elementwise passes (scale into scores, G*=U into gelu, residual into norm) to shave non-weight traffic. Threading only revisited if per-token traffic drops.
asi.rollback_reason: 165.43ms vs 158.83ms baseline (+4.2%): extra threads add fork/join + DRAM contention with zero bandwidth headroom; single thread already saturates ~85% of bus

asi.hypothesis: -O3 -mcpu=cortex-a72 improves unrolling/scheduling/prefetch of streaming NEON kernels
asi.note: delta 0.42ms (0.26%) is within Pi thermal noise floor; kept because gates pass, outputs bit-identical (parity by construction), and -O3 is directionally the right default. Confidence to be built by subsequent runs.

asi.hypothesis: fusing elementwise passes (attn scale, gelu*up, norm+residual, C argmax) removes ~100 numpy/ctypes round-trips per token with identical flops
